chunks: Ali from Muhammad from Yunus from Malik al-Juhani, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'If the people knew what reward lies in speaking about al-Bada', they would not languish from speaking about it.'

key_terms.الْبَدَاءِ: al-Bada': the Shia theological doctrine of God's sovereign freedom to alter His apparent decrees, a manifestation of absolute divine power (not ignorance)
key_terms.فَتَرُوا: they would languish, slacken, grow weary and cease

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq (AS) say about the spiritual reward for speaking about al-Bada' in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) urges believers to engage with and affirm the doctrine of al-Bada' — the Shia theological principle affirming God's sovereign freedom to manifest new decisions and alter apparent decrees, not from ignorance but as an expression of absolute power. The Imam underscores the immense spiritual reward attached to discussing this doctrine, implying that the community's neglect of this topic results in a significant loss of divine merit.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Yunus, from Malik Al Juhny who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘If the people knew what Recompense would be in the speech with The Changing of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’s Decision (الْبَدَاءِ), they would not languish from the speaking with regards to it’.
en.sarwar: 12. It is narrated from a number of our peole from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid fro some of our people from Muhammad ibn ‘Amr al-Kufi brother of Yahya from Murazim ibn Hakimwhos has said the following.

I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) saying, “No prophet has ever proclaimed prophethood before acknowledging before Allah about five things. Acknowledgement of al-Bada’, of the wish of Allah, the prostration, affirmation of worshipping and obedience.”
